title: Copy the contents of a file to the clipboard
summary: Use pbcopy to send the text content of a file directly to your clipboard, so you can paste it anywhere.

aliases.text: copy text from file to clipboard
копировать содержимое файла в буфер обмена

steps.explain: Redirect the content of the specified file into pbcopy, which places it on the clipboard.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file whose content you want to copy.
